description: One Immersive Commons member's public profile by handle, as data: { ok, handle, name, profile_url, card_url, profile_v2{ hero{display_name, availability, chips}, stats[{value, label, source_note?, source_url?, kind ('self_reported' = the member's own claim | 'computed' = derived by IC from GitHub)}], now[{label, text}], offers[{title, body?, cta, meeting_type, booking_page}], log[{id, lane, kind, date, title, body?, url?, url_label?, pinned, updated}] (newest first, <= 50), log_total, log_url, activity (the 12-month chart: weeks, lanes{building, events, writing}, milestones) | null, follow{feed, feed_by_lane, agent} } }. The same profile_v2 block as https://www.immersivecommons.com/m/<handle>/agent.json. Drafts never appear. Members are private by default, and an unknown, private, operator-hidden or retired handle all return the SAME { ok:false, error, error_kind:'not_found' }, so this is not a membership oracle; a retired handle of a public member is followed to the current one. Read-only. No auth required. Args: { handle }.

handle.description: The member's IC handle, as in https://www.immersivecommons.com/m/<handle>.

name: ic_member_profile_get
title: A member's public profile as data (public)
